loss: square root of equally weighted season mean squared game-margin errors
selection: Smallest shared lambda within 0.05 development RMSE of the empirical best, also passing a simultaneous all-pair one-sided 95% centered-bootstrap upper bound. Reference stays fixed at 150000. No refinement.
publication_gate: Freeze development choice before later diagnostics. Publish it only if its one-sided 95th-percentile paired bootstrap RMSE difference versus corrected 150000 is at most 0.05 and no later season deteriorates by more than 0.20 RMSE. Otherwise publish corrected 150000. Never try a replacement lower lambda on diagnostic results.
calibration: For each outcome, fit candidate-specific affine margin calibration on strictly earlier outcomes only. This calibration is for validation, not applied to published coefficients.
population: Exact intersection of cached WP possession game IDs and pinned PULSE regular-season validation game IDs per outcome. Record all excluded IDs; every candidate uses the identical intersection.
chronology: Rebuild changes in contiguous possession_index_before order after refitting the same past-only WP surface with official winner labels. Never use checkpoint pts or stored changes as targets. Preserve source bytes.
surface_features: Unchanged six original progress-WP features. Score inputs are cumulative offense-assigned possession-point proxies, not exact scoreboard states. No terminal-score correction or future information enters features.
actual_outcome: Official home_score minus away_score from hash-verified official_game_scores regular-season partitions. Frozen PULSE/RAPM predictions are rescored against this target, not their stored nontechnical scoring margin.
unplayed_score_entries: Exclude only 0-0 schedule entries. Every possession game must still match a non-tied official result; no winner fallback.
prefit_amendment: Read-only reconciliation found wrong cached WP winners and a PULSE evaluation-target mismatch. Fix labels and outcome definition before any full grid or score inspection. All lambda, epsilon, split and gate choices remain unchanged.
